plan.change: Correct the outdoor night lighting after the author reported that lamps and windows read as unlit and paths are hard to walk.
canonicalSources: PR #942 and its deployed mobile-scale night frames
expectedChanges: Use the shared renderer with an explicit outdoor night exposure, retaining the warm light vs unlit environment distinction and path/actor legibility.

Preserve the authored source masks and daytime results. Calibrate night emission with original glass/lantern hues and source-local facade spill, and expand the ground illumination into visible textured walking areas using a bounded cached pixel falloff.

Deploy new adapter and materials cache revisions. Add regression probes for actual emitted daylight/night luminance separation and bright near/far ground spill; compare actual camera angles including arrival.
ownerDecisions: Author reports that Staging night looks uniformly dark and impedes walking. Treat prior #942 night calibration as rejected. Correct visual legibility within original Staging-only scope.
hqDecisions: Modify only the town night treatment and materials within the existing adapter; reuse the #941 renderer and #942 render passes. No new light sources, objects, camera or control UI.
Leave morning, noon, evening, and OFF identical. Preserve alpha/footY/camera, caching budget, step-based time and ordinary light failures.
rulesApplied: Full Plan and immutable lock before implementation; exact base/head Scope, Risk, Impact and trusted static gates
Pixel Standard, integer draw bounds and nearest sampling; cap cache, never mutate original data or add animation loop
Use independent review and compare actual browser output to pre-change screenshots
plan.rollback: Use ?lighting=off; reverting this single Staging correction returns #942 visual calibration. No migration.
outOfScope: Real clock, automatic progression and permanent UI
Interior assets, editor preview, scene placement and collisions, original assets, gameplay, navigation and persistence
unverified: Physical iPhone Safari timing, thermal behavior and touch feel
plan.problem: Night glass is muddy brown and the small ground pools are barely distinguishable on a phone-sized viewport. The initial spawn and unlit areas can lack a visual walking reference.
plan.currentContract: The renderer accepts explicit phase parameters. #942 already caches per-period world art, masks, and ground effects; fixed noon and ?lighting= override.
plan.whyExistingIsInsufficient: Previous checks confirmed coordinates and geometry, without requiring a visible light source, illuminated pavement and readable walking routes.
plan.design: Use a modest town-specific night ambient and brighter authored source cores with restrained pixel-quantized local spill on opaque features. Grade the intensity from each light to the pavement, preserving texture, source hue and hard image contours.
alternativesRejected: Change the four shared renderer presets for all callers
Uniform screen brightening as the only correction
Fake lights, broad blur, new HUD controls, avatar torch or clocks
plan.migration: No persisted change; five outdoor maps share in-memory period across moves.
plan.compatibility: Fallback on missing renderer, image or map failure. Preserve input, editor and overlay order, work routing and cache-busted script URLs.
boundaryCases: Noon original ambient pixels; all four street lamps; different shop ground anchors and lamp delivery scale
Changing maps, camera, screen size, period; optional module or source missing/invalid
Noon/off, indoor and authoring special sprites, loading/error paths, repeated cycles and mobile budget
testPlan: Compare phone-sized same-camera previous/current night on station, lamps, both shop pairs, all three source-free routes and player. Inspect default arrival cameras as well as close approaches.
Test emitted light against surrounding wood, source-local facades, footprint near/far falloff, and unlit-path visibility. Compare full frames for morning/noon/evening/OFF byte equality to #942.
Check Chromium and Linux WebKit, native scene and editor regressions, cache/loops, walking/tap/transitions and error fallback; physical iPhone pending.
Run trusted base Scope/Risk/Impact and Static checks, exact PR head CI and review, then verify merge SHA and Pages-delivered bytes.
plan.promotionRisk: Staging-only correction requested by author. Visual adoption and iPhone hardware remain separate.
